messages:
Aisha (People Ops): Quick q for managers — we have a handful of folks on parental leave and a couple of new hires who joined mid-cycle. How should managers complete review forms and calibration entries for them?
Ben (Manager - Core Platform): For folks on leave, I usually do a performance snapshot + note that they were on LOA for part of the cycle. Is that what you want? :thinking_face: 
Carla (Manager - ML): Same. For new hires (<90 days) I mark 'insufficient data' and add a short narrative, then include any ramp goals. We still need them in calibration so the committee can see context.
Aisha (People Ops): Thanks — want to formalize to avoid inconsistent scoring. Proposal: three categories for managers to choose when filling forms: "Full cycle", "Partial data (LOA)" or "New hire <90d". Each choice requires a one-line rationale. Does that work?
Ben (Manager - Core Platform): Works for me. Quick question: for "Partial data (LOA)", should managers still give a provisional rating or leave blank?
Raj (HRBP): Provisional rating is fine but must be flagged. We'll treat those as "deferred finalization" during calibration. The calibration packet will surface all flagged provisional ratings.
Carla (Manager - ML): Can we add guidance text near the rating field? Something like: "If employee had >30% LOA in cycle, select 'Partial data' and provide note; provisional ratings will be discussed in calibration."
Aisha (People Ops): Yep — I'll update the form copy. Draft guidance snippet:```
Guidance for managers: If the employee was on unpaid or paid leave for a significant portion of the review period (>30%), select 'Partial data (LOA)'. Provide a 1-2 sentence summary of observed impact and any outstanding evidence. Assign a provisional rating if needed; mark for calibration discussion. For new hires (<90 days) select 'New hire <90d' and add ramp goals.```
PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: Performance review forms due in 48 hours for most orgs. Link: https://docs.internal/redwood/reviews/forms :bell: 
Ben (Manager - Core Platform): Important — one more edge case: contractors transitioning to full-time during the window. Do we include them?
Raj (HRBP): Contractors who converted to FTE during the cycle should get a partial entry like new hires, but call out conversion date. We'll include a filter in the calibration packet so reviewers can see conversion events.
Aisha (People Ops): OK — final checklist I'll add to the forms page and email: 1) Select category (Full cycle / Partial data (LOA) / New hire <90d / Contractor->FTE) 2) Provide 1-2 sentence rationale 3) If provisional rating assigned, check the "Flag for calibration" box 4) Link any evidence (projects, PRs) 5) Notify HRBP if you need an exception deadline.
Carla (Manager - ML): Can People Ops make a short dropdown in the form so managers don't have to type the category every time? Saves a lot.
Aisha (People Ops): Yep dropdown + required rationale field. I'm pushing an update now and will post a link when live. Expect the email update in ~30m.
Ben (Manager - Core Platform): Nice — will remind my leads to use the dropdown and flag provisional ratings.
PeopleOps Bot: Note: Calibration meeting slots are being scheduled for next Tues/Wed. If you have >3 flagged provisional ratings, please request an expanded slot here: https://calendly.internal/redwood/calibration-requests
Aisha (People Ops): Thanks all — if anyone wants a quick 1:1 walkthrough of the new copy/forms before I publish, ping me. :thumbsup:
